mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced discount rates compressing equity valuation multiples during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: The average 5-day S&P 500 return is not positive (mean <= 0) when FEDFUNDS is in the lowest quartile of its historical distribution over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending capacity and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a 0.2 percentage point monthly CPI increase signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index signals robust manufacturing activity and stronger economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day SPX return is not positive (mean <= 0) when INDPRO is in the top quartile of its historical distribution over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300.0 thousand units signal weak residential investment and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in employment growth and rising unemployment indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In slow-growth regimes (annual GDP growth < 1.0%), a quarterly GDP growth decline signals recession risk, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate (q/q) declines from previous quarter
failure_condition: In slow-growth regimes (annual GDP growth < 1.0%), SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate (q/q) declines from previous quarter.
